title: The ML Lifecycle
outcome: By the end, I can explain the ml lifecycle using a traced example and a stated limitation.
scenario: Follow one complete plant-classifier lifecycle without tuning on the final test.
given: Toy training leaves have widths 1 healthy, 3 healthy, 5 spotted, 7 spotted. Candidates predict spotted at width>=2 or >=4.
All inputs and outcomes in this worked example are invented classroom data; no real model run is claimed.

steps.label: Fit using training
steps.detail: Cutoff 2 makes one error at width 3; cutoff 4 makes zero training errors.

steps.label: Freeze candidate
steps.detail: Choose cutoff 4 under the stated training-error rule.

steps.label: Test once
steps.detail: Fresh leaves width 2 healthy and 6 spotted are both predicted correctly: 2/2.

explanation: Read the picture in order. Fresh leaves width 2 healthy and 6 spotted are both predicted correctly: 2/2. The arrows show which recorded input or intermediate result each decision uses. Explain the deciding step aloud before checking the changed case; pointing to the final answer alone does not show how it follows.

counterfactual.change: The fresh width-6 leaf is actually healthy.
counterfactual.prediction: The frozen model is correct on 1/2 test leaves.
counterfactual.reason: The supplied reference changed; moving the cutoff after seeing this test would reuse final evidence for development.

student_task: Should the team silently retune on the changed test? Point to the relevant step in the picture, then write the changed result and the rule or evidence that supports it.
teacher_answer: No. Report 1/2 for the frozen model. Any revision needs development data and a newly reserved final evaluation. Changed-case check: The frozen model is correct on 1/2 test leaves. The supplied reference changed; moving the cutoff after seeing this test would reuse final evidence for development.
project_evidence: For your Responsible Plant Classifier, save the input, procedure, observed result and limitation of this check. Label this worked example as practice; use a different, previously unreviewed case when checking independent understanding.
limits: Two invented test leaves cannot establish useful real-world plant classification.
review_note: Reviewed The ML Lifecycle against the assigned lesson pack and its reserved independent case. Added a different explicit worked scenario, an auditable trace and a changed-input check; preserved the original curriculum and assessment boundary.
